policy: These targets define pending external-evidence collection only. They must not accept user-provided Hi-net text, screenshots, local captures, or EQuake source estimates as catalog truth. A case can clear review only after hinet_truth_quality_review_decisions.json records an accepted decision with reviewer metadata and a revised Hi-net or JMA final-catalog source.

sourceAvailabilityChecks.catalogScope: Public map for the past 30 days; Hi-net automatic data for the latest two days and JMA unified data for older entries.
sourceAvailabilityChecks.notes: The public map helps locate recent epicenters, but it is not an event-level revised Hi-net or final JMA catalog record with reviewer metadata.

sourceAvailabilityChecks.catalogScope: Preliminary catalog by the Hi-net automatic system.
sourceAvailabilityChecks.notes: Unauthenticated access returns the registered-user login page. Even if retrieved, this catalog is preliminary and still requires explicit review before split acceptance.

sourceAvailabilityChecks.catalogScope: JMA unified hypocenter catalog provided through the Hi-net registered-user area.

sourceAvailabilityChecks.catalogScope: NIED describes the Hi-net automatic catalog as preliminary and recommends JMA official/final catalog use for formal reference.
sourceAvailabilityChecks.notes: This policy supports keeping user-provided Hi-net labels reference-only until event-level revised or final catalog evidence is recorded.
